models_evaluated: ED ECG screening prediction model for STEMI (CDS)

links.outcome: Agreement of silent in vivo CDS with in vitro model; errors detected
links.effect: Over a 2-month silent pilot of 18,335 encounters, raw agreement 95.5% (CI 95.2%-95.9%), kappa 87.6% (CI 86.7%-88.6%); additional coding errors identified and corrected.
links.quote: CDS fidelity to the model reflected raw agreement of 95.5% (CI, 95.2%-95.9%) and kappa of 87.6% (CI, 86.7%-88.6%).

links.outcome: Coding errors uncovered by silent-mode fidelity analysis on live data
links.effect: Silent pilot on live data found additional coding errors, which were corrected before clinical use.
links.quote: Additional coding errors were identified and were corrected.

links.outcome: Technical component testing of CDS coding before activation
links.effect: Technical Component Analysis identified several small coding errors in CDS components, which were addressed.
links.quote: The Technical Component Analysis indicated several small coding errors in CDS components that were addressed.

models_evaluated: Predictive model identifying emergency department patients requiring an ECG within 10 minutes of arrival

links.outcome: Agreement between live CDS and in vitro model screening decisions during silent piloting
links.effect: Across 18 335 encounters, raw agreement was 95.5% (CI, 95.2%-95.9%) and kappa was 87.6% (CI, 86.7%-88.6%). Additional coding errors were identified and corrected.
links.quote: CDS fidelity to the model reflected raw agreement of 95.5% (CI, 95.2%-95.9%) and kappa of 87.6% (CI, 86.7%-88.6%).

links.outcome: Detection and correction of CDS component coding errors before clinical activation
links.effect: Technical Component Analysis identified several small coding errors in CDS components, which were addressed; no error count was reported.
links.quote: The Technical Component Analysis indicated several small coding errors in CDS components that were addressed.

links.effect: Running the model as a silent pilot on live data revealed several small coding errors that were addressed.

links.effect: Technical component analysis uncovered several small coding errors in the clinical decision support coding.
links.quote: The Technical Component Analysis indicated several small coding errors in CDS components that were addressed.
